inspiration.observed_pattern: A scalar TIMEDIFF returns the elapsed TIME between two fixed time values.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored scalar TIMEDIFF projection with no table, classification, or NULL row so MariaDB's TIME result metadata is isolated.

fixture_notes: The fixed times produce a four-hour, one-minute, one-second elapsed TIME value that isolates TIMEDIFF metadata.
determinism_notes: Both TIME literals are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
